verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an SDK (with CRUD code examples) and a CLI for programmatically creating, syncing and deploying apps, which lets AI-native users drive the platform outside the UI (base44-docs-4, base44-docs-23, base44-docs-28, base44-docs-5, base44-docs-24). However, a probe for a formal OpenAPI/REST spec returned 404s across all standard paths, indicating no canonical public API reference beyond the SDK/CLI docs. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI specification, independent third-party corroboration of API usage, and evidence of API stability/versioning guarantees.
